explanations: pending() treats every migration numbered at or below the highest applied version as already done. Version numbers are claimed when a PR is opened, so 0005 and 0006 reached production before 0004 merged. After that, 0004 is below the high-water mark and is skipped forever. migrate() says there is nothing to do, status() reports it as applied, and the boot check passes, while the column is missing. Fresh databases are fine because they run everything in one pass. The fix computes pending as the migrations whose version isn't recorded in schema_migrations (a set difference) and still applies them in version order.
